Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!

ex.s: I just want a job that earns an honest income.
ex.t: 我只想要一份能赚诚实收入的工作。

ex.s: About 20% of all American meals are eaten in the car, and Americans spend about 10% of their income on fast food.
ex.t: 大约20%的美国餐食是在车里吃的，美国人把大约10%的收入花在快餐上。

ex.s: Moreover, her company’s annual income has reached six million yuan and more than 50 new jobs have been created.
ex.t: 而且，她公司的年收入已达到六百万元，并创造了50多个新的工作岗位。

ex.s: During six years with no income, he had to depend on his wife.
ex.t: 在没有收入的六年里，他不得不依靠他的妻子。
